verdict.rationale: A local emulator or simulator that matches the production runtime is a fair question for a cloud app platform, but the evidence never documents one for Fly.io. The closest item describes editing locally while running a GPU on Fly.io. That is remote execution, not local simulation. Fly building Machines from Docker images is likewise not a first-party local runtime simulator.

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime
